data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value:
These are the different Properties a Form in Visual Basic.Net have:
1. AcceptButton - returns or sets the button automatically clicked when the user presses the "Enter" key on their keyboard.
2. ActiveForm - returns the currently active form in the application.
3. ActiveMidChild - returns the currently active Multiple-Document Interface (MDI) child window.
4. AllowDrop - returns or sets whether the form adjusts to fit the font used and scales its controls.
5. AutoScroll - returns or sets a value indicating whether the form enables autoscrolling.
6. AutoSizeMode - returns or sets the mode by which the form automatically resizes itself.
7. BackColor - sets the color of the background.
8. CancelButton - returns or sets the button control that is clicked when the user presses the ESC key.
9. ClientSize - reutnrs or sets the size of the client area of the form.
10. ControlBox - returns or sets a value indicating whether a control box is displayed in the caption bar of the form.
11. Cursor - returns or sets the mouse cursor when the mouse is over the form.
12. DialogResult - returns or sets the dialog result for the form.
13. Font - returns or sets the text font in the form.
14. ForeColor - returns or sets the foreground color of the form.
15. FormBorderStyle - returns or sets the border style of the form.
16. Height - returns or sets the form's height in pixels.
17. Icon - returns or sets the icon for the form.
18. IsMidChild - returns a value indicating whether the form is a Multiple-Document Interface (MDI) child form.
19. Location - returns or sets the coordinates of the upper-left corner of the form with respect to the upper-left corner of the screen.
20. MaximizeBox - returns or sets a value indicating whether the Maximize button is displayed in the caption bar of the form.
21. MaximumSize - returns the maximum size the form can resized to.
22. MidChildren - returns an array of forms that represent the Multiple-Document Interface (MDI) child forms that are parented to the selected form.
23. MidParent - returns or sets the current MDI parent form of the selected form.
24. Menu - returns or sets the menu that is displayed in the form.
25. MinimizeBox - returns or sets a value indicating whether the Minimize button is displayed in the caption bar of the form.
26. MinimumSize - returns or sets the minimum size the form can be resized to.
27. Modal - returns a value indicating whether the form is displayed modally.
28. Name - returns or sets the name of the form.
29. Opacity - returns or sets the opacity level of the form.
30. OwnedForms - returns an array of Form objects that represent all forms that are owned by a Form.
31. Owner - returns or sets the form that owns the form.
32. ShownInTaskBar - returns or sets a value indicating whether the form is displayed in the Windows Taskbar.
33. Size - returns or sets the size of the form.
34. StartPosition - returns or sets the starting position of the form at run time.
35. Text - returns or sets the text in the title bar.
36. TopMost - returns or sets a value indicating whether the form should be displayed as a topmost form.
37. TransparencyKey - returns or sets the color that will represent the areas of the form.
38. Visible - returns or sets whether the form is visible.
39. Width - returns or sets the width of the form (in pixel).
40. WindowState - returns or sets the form's window state.
